question: For the district with the highest percentage increase in unemployment from 1995 to 1996, find the account ID of the oldest female client who resides there. Also, include the difference between the highest and lowest average salaries across all districts.

prediction.sql:
WITH target_district AS (
    SELECT XCL_017
    FROM district
    WHERE XCL_028 IS NOT NULL AND XCL_028 <> 0
    ORDER BY (XCL_029 - XCL_028) / CAST(XCL_028 AS REAL) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
oldest_female_account AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_001
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_009 = d.XCL_014
    JOIN account a ON d.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
      AND c.XCL_012 = (SELECT XCL_017 FROM target_district)
    ORDER BY c.XCL_011 ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
salary_range AS (
    SELECT MAX(XCL_026) - MIN(XCL_026) AS salary_diff
    FROM district
)
SELECT ofa.XCL_001, sr.salary_diff
FROM oldest_female_account ofa
CROSS JOIN salary_range sr

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH target_district AS (
    SELECT XCL_017
    FROM district
    WHERE XCL_028 IS NOT NULL AND XCL_028 <> 0
    ORDER BY (XCL_029 - XCL_028) / CAST(XCL_028 AS REAL) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
oldest_female_account AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_001
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_009 = d.XCL_014
    JOIN account a ON d.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
      AND c.XCL_012 = (SELECT XCL_017 FROM target_district)
    ORDER BY c.XCL_011 ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
salary_range AS (
    SELECT MAX(XCL_026) - MIN(XCL_026) AS salary_diff
    FROM district
)
SELECT ofa.XCL_001, sr.salary_diff
FROM oldest_female_account ofa
CROSS JOIN salary_range sr
